task: ae.cc: ChaCha20, Poly1305, RFC 8439 AEAD, X25519 and strict Ed25519 from scratch, checked by RFC vectors, JDK differential tests and a mutation check
reasoning_summary: Tests were written first from RFC 8439/7748/8032 vectors plus JDK 21 differential oracles; all 25 passed on the first run. A 25-mutant pass found one real gap (range checks on y>=p, S>=L and negative-zero were masked by the signature equation); it was closed with torsion-point and identity-key fixtures where only the range check decides the outcome.
